root.label: Mediapart authenticates messages attributed to Jordan Bardella

events.label: Mediapart authenticates messages attributed to Jordan Bardella

slots.name: message date
slots.sentence: Mediapart published screenshots of the antisemitic messages Bardella is said to have sent to another person on Facebook's Messenger chat platform in 2013.

slots.name: Bardella age
slots.sentence: Bardella, 31, has strongly denied writing the messages and on Thursday said he would file a legal case against the Mediapart outlet for defamation, as well as "forgery and use of forgeries".

slots.name: Le Pen age
slots.sentence: She is riding high in the polls, and the 58-year-old has strongly defended Bardella, who has helped the party make inroads among younger voters.

slots.name: Le Pen campaign count
slots.sentence: Le Pen has voiced her "total confidence" in Bardella and denounced a "total war" against her party as she makes a fourth attempt to win the presidency.

slots.name: months to election
slots.sentence: The allegations against Jordan Bardella come just seven months out from the election where voters will choose a replacement for President Emmanuel Macron,
